name: Long-term -80 °C storage of plasmid-bearing bacteria as 25% glycerol stocks in 2 mL screw-top cryovials (Addgene protocol)
plain_name: Bank bacteria and their plasmids in a minus-80 freezer
description: 500 uL of overnight culture is mixed with 500 uL of 50% glycerol in a 2 mL screw-top cryovial, frozen and kept at -80 °C, where it stays viable for years; the stock is kept on dry ice when streaked so it does not thaw.
keywords: Bank bacteria and their plasmids in a minus-80 freezer

sources.citation: Addgene Protocol: Creating Bacterial Glycerol Stocks for Long-term Storage of Plasmids

requirements.rationale: The stock is stored at -80 °C (193.15 K) for years.
Optional handling: keep the vial on dry ice while streaking so it does not thaw.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
